title: Embedding of a finite coordinate set
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and enumerate its elements by the canonical bijection from $\{0,\ldots,|J|-1\}$ to $J$. The embedding of these positions into $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ sends each position to the corresponding element of $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
